Sitenizin Google verisi, kendi bilgisaya: Your site's Google data, on your computer.
Google'ın siteniz için tuttuğu sayıları: See what Google knows about your site, and what is broken on it, on one screen. Free and open source. Installs on Windows from a single file. No account, and your data never leaves your computer.
Windows 10 veya 11 yüklü bir bilgisayara: Installs on a computer running Windows 10 or 11. If you're reading on your phone, send this page to yourself and open it on the computer.
Verinizi Google'dan okur, kimseye gönder: It reads your data from Google and sends it nowhere.
Uygulama yalnızca kendi bilgisayarınızda: The app opens only from your own computer. It talks to two places outside it: Google and the pages of the site you audit. Your data goes nowhere else. Your Google access key is stored encrypted on your computer.
Search Console'un verdiği sayıları, ne y: Search Console's numbers, turned into screens that tell you what to do.
These are the app's own screens. The interface is in Turkish; the English guide names every screen and button. The site and the numbers are examples.
Hangi sayfaya bu hafta dokunmalıyım?: Which page should I work on this week?
Google'da görünen sayfalarınızı dört gru: Sorts your pages into four groups: rarely clicked, close to page one, already near the top, and buried. Each page gets a suggested next step, so you don't have to guess.
Sitede neyin bozuk olduğunu Google'a sor: See what's broken on your site without asking Google.
Siteyi sayfa sayfa gezer ve 95 şeye baka: Crawls the site page by page and checks 95 things: broken links, missing or overly long titles, slow pages, URLs Google can't read. Under every finding it says what to do, and no technical background needed. <a class="textlink" href="/docs/site-denetimi/" >Site audit guide</a >.
Tıklama, gösterim, oran ve sıra; on altı: Clicks, impressions, click-through rate and position; 16 months back.
Sorguya, sayfaya, ülkeye ve cihaza göre: You can look by query, page, country and device. A separate tab shows where two of your pages compete for the same query. <a class="textlink" href="/docs/arama-performansi/" >Search performance guide</a >.
İsterseniz bir yapay zekâ asistanı bağla: Connect an AI assistant if you want.
Claude Code, Codex ya da Cursor uygulama: Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can read the app's data. There are ready-made tasks for audits, traffic-drop investigations, monthly checks and reports. The setup text is ready on screen; you copy it and paste it into the assistant. The app works fully without one. <a class="textlink" href="/docs/ajan-kurulumu/" >Assistant setup guide</a >.
What it does and what it doesn't.
Yalnızca Google'ın size zaten verdiği ve: It only reads the data Google already gives you. It doesn't sell estimates.
Tıklama, gösterim, oran ve sıra; sorguya: Clicks, impressions, rate and position, by query, page, country and device. The app also keeps its own archive, so over time you can look back further.
Kırık bağlantı, eksik ya da çok uzun baş: Broken links, missing or overly long titles, slow pages, URLs Google can't read. Under every finding it says what to do.
Google her sayfanız için ne diyor: dizin: Google's own answer for each of your pages: is it indexed, why not, and when it was last crawled.
Sayfalarınız dört grupta, uğraşmaya en d: Your pages in four groups, ordered by how worthwhile they are to work on. It says which page to start with right next to it.
Rapor tek dosya olur. Telefonda açarsını: Single-file reports that open on a phone, print, and can be emailed. Your assistant can write them if you like.
Claude Code, Codex ya da Cursor bağlarsa: If you connect Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, the assistant reads your numbers, runs the audit and writes the report. It comes with 6 ready-made tasks.
Arama hacmi tahmin etmez; gösterim sayıs: It doesn't estimate search volume; impression counts come from Google.
Size bağlantı veren siteleri (backlink): It doesn't count the sites that link to you (backlinks).
Rakip sıralaması izlemez; yalnızca kendi: It doesn't track competitor rankings; it only reads your own sites.
Bulutta çalışmaz; tek kullanıcı, tek bil: It doesn't run in the cloud; one user, one computer.

The installer isn't code-signed yet. On the SmartScreen screen, choose "More info" first, then "Run anyway". The file's fingerprint (SHA-256) is listed on each release's page if you want to compare it. <a class="textlink" href="/docs/sorun-giderme/" >Troubleshooting</a >.
<code>%LOCALAPPDATA%\\seowatcher</code>: In the %LOCALAPPDATA%\seowatcher folder. The database, your Google access key and the logs are there. Uninstalling the app leaves this folder alone; to make a backup, just copy it.
Neden Google tarafında bir anahtar oluşt: Why do I have to create a Google access key?
Çünkü seowatcher bir bulut hizmeti değil: Because the app isn't a cloud service. Your computer connects to Google directly, and Google wants to know who the connecting app belongs to. You do it once, and the app explains it step by step.
Sayılar Search Console'dakiyle aynı mı?: Are the numbers the same as in Search Console?
Aynı kaynaktan okunur. Google veriyi yak: They're read from the same source. Google's data lags by about three days and leaves out rarely searched queries. The app shows the page total and the site total separately. The two may not match, and that isn't an error.
Sitemi internete açmadan kullanabilir mi: Do I need to expose anything to the internet?
Evet, zaten öyle çalışır. Uygulama yalnı: No. The app opens only from your own computer and reads Search Console and Analytics data from Google. For the site audit, it only crawls the pages of the site you're auditing.
